# Working toward a complete alignment and governance account

**Current scope, 6 October 2026:** the [final coordinating acceptance][candidate] closes the conditional candidate foundation under its five unchanged criteria. Accepted [plasticity](EVALUATIVE-PLASTICITY.md) and [grounding](EVALUATIVE-GROUNDING.md) supersede the earlier prospective statuses. The [frontier comparison][frontier] retains specific contribution candidates while finding no established general alignment advantage. The full seven-requirement goal below remains open; the next practical connection is selective warranted revision through verified effects.

## What is now connected

The [accepted grounding application](EVALUATIVE-GROUNDING.md) now closes the formerly pending connection from materially formed influence to a separately justified response. Actual recipient losses and returns identify the proposed repair episode; patient entitlement, responsibility or entrusted role, adequate permissible remedy and full comparison establish its ground. Learned influence then mediates the paid response. Its later matched destructive revision shows why acquisition does not validate itself. The [completed conditional foundation][candidate] incorporates that result and existing generic correction without claiming one unrestricted physical lineage.

replacements.old: **Explain the remaining evaluative input.** The acquired coefficient and its use are established under a supplied connection, sign and interpretation. The [prospective plasticity study](EVALUATIVE-PLASTICITY.md) asks whether actual paired consequences can form an initially absent operative connection. It has no accepted outcome at this checkpoint. A successful result would reduce that particular causal premise; association alone would still not prove that the target has standing, that a predicted benefit is good for it, or that the actor has authority. The causal and ethical arguments must identify their separate work rather than substituting either for the other.
replacements.new: **Reuse the completed conditional evaluative account.** Operative formation, paid revision and conditional warranted use are accepted. Their supplied architecture and independently defended application premises remain explicit. The next work should test reliable use of those grounds in an identified continuing application; it should not repeat empty-link formation or treat learning as its own ethical standard.

replacements.old: **Complete the shared premise, composition, regime and evidence account.** Trace each claimed transition to its actual input and output, distinguish constructive from destructive outcomes for each affected center, and identify which results share a physical history. The [premise ledger](FOUNDATION-PREMISES.md), [fixed finish-line audit][finish] and [evidence synthesis](EMPIRICAL-SCOPE.md) already supply much of this work. A final account must resolve their remaining explanatory interfaces and make a defensible scope statement; a polished summary alone cannot discharge them. New empirical work is warranted where a retained prediction or practical claim exceeds existing observations, rather than merely because another experiment is possible.
replacements.new: **Preserve the accepted common account while testing stronger claims.** The [premise ledger](FOUNDATION-PREMISES.md), [composition map](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/FOUNDATION-COMPOSITION.md), [evidence synthesis](EMPIRICAL-SCOPE.md) and [final acceptance][candidate] close the conditional synthesis obligation. New practical claims must preserve actual resources, meanings, evidence and effects. The [comparative application contract](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/foundation-assessment/FRONTIER-NEXT-APPLICATION.md) proposes a discriminating continuation against an equally informed ordinary controller; it is not a completed trial or an additional foundation criterion.
